description: 경기도_하수슬러지 처리 집계 현황 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경기도. 이 데이터는 경기도 내 각 시군의 하수처리장에서 발생하는 하수슬러지의 연간 처리 현황을 제공하며, 재활용량, 육상매립, 해양투기, 소각, 연료화, 미처분량(이월량), 기타처분 등 다양한. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
